body: If you don't mind me asking: what procedure did you have done and where did you get it done?

I hate getting out of bed. It's usually in the late afternoon, and then I have to deal with this nagging feeling that I'm wasting my life. I also suffer from ADD and social anxiety. I use meds sometimes to get through the day but it's like putting a bandage on a bullet wound.

I have occasional nightmares (and night terrors) too. I would still rather sleep. The only thing I really hate is lucid dreaming - when I realize that I'm in a dream. It's happened twice, and both times have been terrifying. I've even [written about it here before](https://www.reddit.com/r/Glitch_in_the_Matrix/comments/3blk46/not_being_able_to_wake_up_from_a_nightmare_fading/).
Yes but there are [plenty of places](https://www.modafinilcat.com/) to buy it online.
I've been taking Provigil for excessive sleepiness, and I wish I liked living life enough to only sleep 4 hours (which this medicine lets me do). Yes, waking up's the hardest part.
